signals.description: CAREER: BIOENGINEERING OF A HUMAN BLOOD-SPINAL CORD BARRIER-ON-A-CHIP -THE HUMAN BODY HAS A PROTECTIVE SHIELD BETWEEN THE BLOODSTREAM AND THE CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM (CNS). THIS SHIELD INCLUDES THE BLOOD-SPINAL CORD BARRIER (BSCB). THE BSCB STRICTLY CONTROLS WHICH MOLECULES ENTER THE SPINAL CORD. A DAMAGED OR COMPROMISED BSCB CAN CONTRIBUTE TO NEUROLOGICAL DISORDERS, INCLUDING SPINAL CORD INJURIES AND AMYOTROPHIC LATERAL SCLEROSIS (ALS). STUDYING THESE DISEASES OR TESTING NEW TREATMENTS IS CHALLENGING, BECAUSE RESEARCHERS DO NOT HAVE LABORATORY MODELS THAT ACCURATELY MIMIC THE BSCB. THIS CAREER

THE PROJECT INCLUDES IMPROVEMENTS AT VARIOUS LOCATIONS ON THE LSRC HURON SUBDIVISION BETWEEN ALPENA, MICHIGAN AND PINCONNING, MICHIGAN. signals.description: THIS PARTNER SPECIALIZES IN PRODUCING HIGH QUALITY HARDWOOD LUMBER, RAILROAD TIES, AND CANTS. WOOD IS SOURCED FROM PRIVATE LANDOWNERS AND STATE FORESTS, INCLUDING THE HOOSIER NATIONAL FOREST. THIS AWARD WILL ALLOW THE OPTIMIZATION OF THE EDGER SYSTEM AND THE ADDITION OF A CLEEREMAN GANG BOX. BY IMPROVING PRODUCTION CAPACITY, EXPECTATIONS ARE A 2,000 BOARD FEET PER DAY INCREASE IN PRODUCTION, WHICH, OVER 250 PRODUCTION DAYS, WILL RESULT IN 500,000 ADDITIONAL BOARD FEET ANNUALLY. THE PROJECT WILL ALSO ALLOW THE PURCHASE OF 92 ADDITIONAL SEMI-LOADS OF LOGS ANNUALLY, SUPPORTING LOCAL LOGGERS.

signals.infer: キルン新設に伴い、乾燥炉・搬送設備・木材グレーディング検査装置などの需要が発生する可能性(推論)。
signals.description: THE GRANT FUNDS WILL COVER EXPENSES RELATED TO KILN DESIGN, ENGINEERING, SITE PREPARATION, AND INSTALLATION. THE NEW EQUIPMENT WILL IMPROVE OPERATIONAL EFFICIENCY, INCREASING ANNUAL PRODUCTION. THIS INCREASE IN THROUGHPUT SUPPORTS OUR LONG TERM SUSTAINABILITY GOALS BY MAXIMIZING RESOURCE UTILIZATION AND REDUCING MATERIAL WASTE. BY ENHANCING THE GRADE AND VOLUME OF LUMBER OUTPUT, THIS PROJECT WILL STRENGTHEN THE INDUSTRY AND CONTRIBUTE TO THE ECONOMIC VITALITY OF OUR REGION.

signals.summary: Forest Scienceの助成金$300kにより、ミシガン州アッパー半島の製材会社S&L Lumberが高効率リソーソー、スキャナー、屋内タイグレーディングステーションを導入し、老朽設備を更新して生産能力を20%増強する。
signals.infer: 製材加工設備(リソーソー・光学スキャナー・グレーディング装置)の更新需要があり、木材加工機械メーカーにとって商機となる可能性(推論)。
signals.description: THIS PROJECT INCLUDES THE PURCHASE AND INSTALLATION OF A HIGH-EFFICIENCY WEST PLAINS RESAW, A RESAWX SCANNER, AND AN INDOOR TIE GRADING STATION WITH ERGONOMIC ENHANCEMENTS AT A LUMBER COMPANY IN MICHIGAN'S UPPER PENINSULA. THESE INVESTMENTS WILL MODERNIZE AGING EQUIPMENT, IMPROVE SAFETY, AND INCREASE PRODUCTION CAPACITY BY 20%. THESE UPGRADES WILL ENHANCE THE MILL'S CAPACITY TO PROCESS SUSTAINABLY SOURCED TIMBER FROM PUBLIC LANDS. IN ADDITION, THE PROJECT WILL CREATE THREE NEW FULL-TIME POSITIONS, CONTRIBUTING TO THE ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT OF IRON COUNTY, MICHIGAN.

signals.summary: 米国森林局(Forest Service)がウィスコンシン州の薪製造業者Hack-Away Forest Products社に$300kを助成。老朽化した2基の窯を高効率ステンレス製の急速乾燥キルンに更新し、年間4000コード分の追加生産を目指すほか、ハンドリング・袋詰めシステムの更新と新型薪処理装置の導入を行う。
signals.infer: 生産能力倍増に伴い、乾燥キルン・搬送装置・袋詰め機・薪処理ユニットなど産業機器メーカーへの新規発注需要が生じる可能性(推論)。
signals.description: THIS PROJECT WILL MODERNIZE CRITICAL ASPECTS OF THE OPERATIONS TO MEET INCREASING DEMAND FOR KILN-DRIED FIREWOOD AND SUPPORT SUSTAINABLE FORESTRY. CENTRAL TO THE PROJECT IS THE REPLACEMENT OF TWO OUTDATED KILNS WITH HIGH-EFFICIENCY STAINLESS STEEL FAST KILNS, WHICH WILL REDUCE DRYING TIMES BY MORE THAN HALF, DOUBLING PRODUCTION CAPACITY TO PROCESS AN ADDITIONAL 4000 CORDS ANNUALLY. TO FURTHER ENHANCE EFFICIENCY AND PRODUCT QUALITY, THE PROJECT WILL UPGRADE THE HANDLING AND BAGGING SYSTEMS FOR FIREWOOD AND INSTALL A NEW ENERGY-EFFICIENT STATIONARY FIREWOOD PROCESSING UNIT.

signals.program_name: DOE 再生可能エネルギー R&D
signals.description:
BIL - SCALEUP AND DEMONSTRATION OF HIGH TEMPERATURE ELECTROLYSIS TECHNOLOGY
